verdict.rationale: Canva documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants work with its design capabilities (generation, editing, discovery, asset and brand management, export, comments), and the probe confirms the docs page exists; there is also a user-facing AI Connector path for personal assistants. Some tools, such as resizing, are limited to Canva Pro and above. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and concrete setup/authentication details (endpoint, client configuration) in the evidence.
